question: Who among the following Indian sportswomen has received the BBC Indian Sportswoman of The Year 2022 award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mirabai Chanu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mirabai Chanu, the silver-medallist weightlifter** from the** Tokyo Olympic Games,** has clinched the prestigious 2022 'BBC Indian Sportswoman of the Year award, securing the honour through a public voting process.
 
• Remarkably, Chanu, hailing from Manipur and aged 28, has achieved the distinction of winning this award for the second consecutive year, having also claimed the title in 2021.
 
• The** 'BBC Indian Sportswoman of the Year award, **established in 2019, aims to recognize and celebrate the accomplishments of Indian sportswomen who have left a significant impact on the global stage.
 
• In addition to Chanu's achievement, table tennis player Bhavina Patel emerged victorious in the inaugural 'BBC Para Sportswoman of the Year' category, introduced this year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Furthermore, **Pritam Siwach**, former captain of the Indian women's hockey team, was honoured with the esteemed 'BBC Lifetime Achievement Award for her substantial contributions to Indian sports and her role in inspiring generations of players.
 
• Finally, boxer Nitu Ghanghas was bestowed with the title of 'BBC Emerging Player of the Year'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nikhat Zareen** is an Indian boxer renowned for her achievements, having clinched the title of world champion twice. Notably, she secured a gold medal at the 2011 AIBA Women's Youth & Junior World Boxing Championships held in Antalya.
 
• **Pusarla Venkata Sindhu,** a prominent figure in Indian badminton, is celebrated as one of the nation's most accomplished athletes. With an impressive track record, Sindhu has garnered medals at prestigious events like the Olympics and various tournaments on the BWF circuit, including a noteworthy gold at the 2019 World Championships.
 
• **Saina Nehwal,** another stalwart in Indian badminton, boasts an illustrious career as a professional player. Formerly ranked as world no. 1, Nehwal has secured an impressive tally of 24 international titles, among which are ten Superseries titles, marking her as one of the most successful players in the sport.
